records.subject: You're in -- let's get Ridge Partners set up
records.body:
Hi Mateo,

Welcome! A lot of new teams ask us the same thing in the first few days: how do I get my team in here. Short answer -- a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Reply any time.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

draft.subject: Picking up where your onboarding call left off
draft.body:
Hi Mateo,

Thanks for flagging the Slack integration and the notification badge last week — both tickets are closed on our end, so do tell me if either resurfaces.

Since our onboarding call, I wanted to help you get Ridge Partners properly underway. In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so a first project is usually the best starting point. When you're ready, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week work? I'm happy to walk through that first project with you.

Best,
Chidi
